current_evidence: The 'Information to accompany a planning application' page (modified 18 May 2026) links 'Local validation requirements in the Yorkshire Dales National Park - December 2025' alongside three December 2025 questionnaires, and the PDF states it is the December 2025 revision replacing the September 2023 edition.

issues.detail: The workbook's 'Validation list URL' is the Full/Outline/Variation validation questionnaire (.doc), one of three application-type questionnaires. It is not the Authority's local validation list. The main list is the 'Local validation requirements December 2025' PDF, which Grokbot also read. The .doc link works but returns a binary Word file.
issues.evidence: Information to accompany a planning application page: 'Local validation requirements in the Yorkshire Dales National Park - December 2025' (PDF) listed separately from the questionnaires

issues.detail: The list date 2026-05-01 comes from the upload folder in the URL path (2026/05). The documents are titled and dated December 2025.
issues.evidence: PDF: 'December 2025 (revised and republished, replacing the September 2023 edition)'; questionnaire filename '...-December-2025.doc'

issues.detail: No app-type row captures Public Right of Way Information. It applies where a right of way crosses, is close to, forms an access route to, or is otherwise affected by the site.
issues.evidence: PDF 4.8 Public Right of Way Information

issues.detail: No app-type row captures the Occupancy Restriction Statement. It is required for proposals of 1-5 new dwellings, or conversion of a traditional building, under local needs policies. The Authority's form was updated in October 2026.
issues.grok_comment: The gap is real: 4.15 requires the statement for 1-5 new dwellings or conversion of a traditional building, and the workbook has no row for it. But the PDF never says the form was updated in October 2026; the only October date is the policy reference "SLDC Core Strategy October 2010".
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The missing Occupancy Restriction Statement stands; the "form updated October 2026" claim is withdrawn.

issues.detail: No app-type row captures the Community Use Assessment, required for development that would lose or adversely affect an existing community facility.

The Farm Buildings Questionnaire (large agricultural buildings) and the Geological Assessment (within or next to an SSSI, Limestone Pavement Order, LNR or RIGS) appear only as fragments in tab_items. Neither has an app-type row.
issues.evidence: PDF 4.17 Farm Buildings Questionnaire; 4.7 Geological Assessment

issues.detail: Under Full planning, the Sustainable Drainage Report (SuDS) for major applications and the Shadow HRA for 2+ dwellings in a nutrient neutrality catchment are not captured as distinct triggers. The 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' row actually quotes the Non Mains Drainage Assessment trigger.
issues.evidence: PDF 4.22 SuDS: Major applications; 4.6 Shadow HRA; 4.10 Non Mains Drainage Assessment

issues.detail: Two Full planning rows quote the wrong trigger. 'Structural Survey' quotes the Conversion Works Method Statement trigger ('when a Structural Survey is not identified as necessary'). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes a tree fragment ('and Arboricultural Method Statement may be required') and is really the Conversion Works Method Statement. The Outline rows for both quote a garbled questionnaire string that runs into the archaeology question.
issues.evidence: PDF 4.12 Structural Survey: conversion of a traditional building showing signs of structural instability; 4.13 Conversion Works Method Statement

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are cut-off fragments that do not state when the requirement applies. Examples: Full planning Air Quality ('by an Air Quality Assessment and a shadow HRA (optional...)'), Agricultural dwelling ('for the functional needs of agriculture, or a ruralbased enterprise.'), Self-build ('Self or Custom build in the title of your application.'), and Householder Ecological Survey (a run-on of questionnaire Yes/No cells).
issues.evidence: PDF 4.23 Air Quality: proposals near SSSIs/SACs/SPAs/Ramsar incl. new slurry/animal housing, increased herd size, anaerobic digesters, combustion plants, traffic-generating development

issues.detail: Under Change of use, the 'Roof plan' row quotes Design and Access Statement text ('3.8 Design and Access Statement When required? Major planning applications...'). The source roof plan trigger is works to an existing roof or a new roof.
issues.evidence: PDF 3.7 Roof plan: where works to an existing roof or a new roof are proposed

issues.detail: The 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' row under every app type quotes only part of the site plan content list ('public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking...'). It is not a separate local requirement.

Several tab_items are submission process, contact details or background text rather than requirements. Examples: the Portal/email submission routes with a 20MB limit, 'phoning the Senior Planning Technician on 01969 652345', 'Altogether SAC, SPA and Ramsar sites cover 23% of the Yorkshire Dales National Park', the BNG link list 'Env Act 2021 Main Gov page...', and the River Eden phosphate background ('In 2022 Natural England notified...').

All roughly 22 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Examples are Affordable Housing, Flood Risk, Contaminated Land, Noise and Nutrient Neutrality. The Full/Outline/Variation questionnaire explicitly covers full, outline and variation applications, yet Variation of conditions is left as '(none)'. The Planning Obligations/S106 row is explanatory text, not a listed validation requirement.
issues.evidence: Questionnaire title 'Full, outline or variation validation questionnaire'

issues.detail: The tab_items sections drawing standard is repeated with trailing question numbers ('...1:20. 9.' and '...1:20. 7.'), and the submission-routes text appears three times.
issues.evidence: tab_items Drawing / document standards; Submission rules

summary: Grokbot linked the Full/Outline/Variation questionnaire instead of the December 2025 local validation requirements PDF, and dated it May 2026 from the upload path. It did read the current documents, but it missed several local requirements (PROW, occupancy restriction, community use, farm buildings, geology) and has many garbled or mismatched triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
